profile_name.description: Profile name passed to gajim via --profile=NAME; used to select $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gajim/NAME/ directory

loglevels.description: List of logging subsystem-level pairs (see --loglevel=SUBSYSTEM=LEVEL in man page). Each item defines a subsystem and its log level. Order preserved for multiple loggers. Valid levels: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL. Example: gajim.c.m=DEBUG → subsystem: gajim.c.m, level: DEBUG

quiet.description: If true, suppress non-critical output (equivalent to -q/--quiet)

verbose.description: If true, print XML stanzas and debug info (equivalent to -v/--verbose)

warnings.description: If true, show all warnings (equivalent to -w/--warnings)

gdebug.description: If true, enable GLib debug messages (equivalent to --gdebug)
